answers.a: Time to correctly access the input

explanations.a: Incorrect. Delay is not related to accessing the input; it refers to the time between input and output.

questions.question: 2. Can we reduce delay to zero?

answers.c: Yes in most of the cases

explanations.a: Incorrect. Delay cannot be reduced to zero due to physical and practical limitations.
explanations.b: Correct. It is not possible to achieve zero delay in real systems.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Delay can be minimized but not eliminated in most cases.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Achieving zero delay is not practical, even in rare cases.

questions.question: 3. The optimum size of each inverter is ________ of its neighbours

explanations.a: Correct. The geometric mean of neighboring inverter sizes gives optimum sizing for minimum delay.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Arithmetic mean does not provide optimum sizing for inverter chains.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Only geometric mean is optimum in this context.
explanations.d: Incorrect. There is a correct option for optimum sizing.

questions.question: 4. What does Cg1 corresponds to in the following formula?

questions.question: 5. If the gate size is increased by n then what will be the effect on its resistance?

questions.question: 6. If the gate size is increased by n then what will be the effect on its capacitance?

questions.question: 7. Choose the correct statement from the following.

answers.a: All the inveters in series are kept to be of same size for minimum delay
answers.b: The inverter size does not matter as long as the inverter driving the load has very big size
answers.c: The inverter size does not matter as long as the inverter driving the load has very small size

explanations.c: Incorrect. A very small inverter driving the load is not optimal for delay.
explanations.d: Correct. The inverter driving the load is usually the largest and a multiple of previous sizes for minimum delay.

questions.question: 9. Let a be the stage ratio of an inverter chain. What is its optimum value to drive a load capacitor with minimum delay?
